Synthesis:
As of September 16, 2026, the latest Node.js LTS is 24.21.0 (“Krypton”), released September 7, 2026. It is Active LTS through October 20, 2027, with security support until April 30, 2028 [1][2][3]. Node.js 22.23.2 (“Jod”) remains supported in Maintenance LTS, while Node.js 26.8.1 is the Current, non-LTS release [4][5].
